english.title: Receive money or consideration for voting or refraining from voting at election

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 113(1) and (5) and 168(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
before or during an election, directly or indirectly by himself or by any other person on his behalf
receives, agrees, or contracts for any money, gift, loan or valuable consideration, office, place or employment
for himself or for any other person
for voting or agreeing to vote or for refraining or agreeing to refrain from voting

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
